name: A1z26withdashseparator

description_json.name: A1Z26WithDashSeparator
description_json.idea: Convert each letter of the alphabet to its 1-based index (A=1, B=2, ..., Z=26), separating each converted number with a dash. Case is ignored (all letters are treated as lowercase). Non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) are left completely unchanged and are not separated by dashes.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
1. Convert the entire string to lowercase.
2. For each character in the string:
   a. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), convert it to its corresponding 1-based alphabet index (a=1, b=2, ..., z=26).
   b. If the next character is also a letter, append a dash '-' after the number.
   c. If the character is not a letter (e.g., space, punctuation, digit), leave it exactly as it is without adding any dashes around it.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
1. Parse the ciphertext from left to right.
2. If a sequence of digits separated by dashes is encountered (e.g., '20-5-19-20'), convert each number back to its corresponding lowercase letter (1=a, 2=b, ..., 26=z) and remove the dashes.
3. If any other character is encountered (spaces, punctuation, digits not representing letters), leave it exactly as it is.
